item.title: Five Tazewell County students' designs selected for new 'I Voted' stickers
item.description: Five students from Pekin Community High School, Pekin Edison Junior High School and Washington Central Grade School designed five different "I Voted" stickers for the upcoming March 17 primary election in Tazewell County, which were selected by the Tazewell County Board out of a large number of submissions.

item.title: Peoria High School basketball coach released after allegedly soliciting a minor
item.description: Peoria High School's boys' varsity basketball coach, Daniel Ruffin, was released from jail two days after being arrested for allegedly having an inappropriate conversation with a 16-year-old girl, and is now on leave pending the investigation.

item.title: Bradley University welcomes Karel Janeček for 48th McCord Lecture series
item.description: Bradley University hosted Karel Janeček, an internationally recognized mathematician and entrepreneur, to speak to students about the importance of understanding probability and finding meaning in life.

item.title: CityLink pays tribute to Rosa Parks with a vacant bus seat
item.description: CityLink buses in Peoria, Illinois left one seat unused on every bus to honor Civil Rights pioneer Rosa Parks on her birthday, with posters and information on black history displayed throughout the Transit Center.

item.title: Show your gratitude: National Thank a Mail Carrier Day
item.description: On National Thank a Mail Carrier Day, the USPS provided tips on how to show appreciation for mail carriers, such as clearing pathways and keeping pets secured.

item.title: Peoria seeks court order to halt casino redevelopment plan
item.description: The city of Peoria has filed a lawsuit against Boyd Gaming, the city of East Peoria and the Illinois Gaming Board to block a proposed $160 million redevelopment plan for the Par-A-Dice casino, citing a 1991 agreement that any casino built on land must be on the Peoria side of the Illinois River.

item.title: Jeffrey Epstein: 'Sorry about Peoria'
item.description: Jeffrey Epstein mentioned Peoria, Illinois in an email released under the Epstein Transparency Act, in response to a redacted person lamenting the death of David Brenner.

item.title: Body cam reveals deputy's tense moments before shooting
item.description: Deputy Jack Evans was shot by Larry Bell while chasing him after a traffic stop in South Peoria, and Bell was charged with five felony counts, including attempted first-degree murder.

item.title: Durbin makes move to regulate big tech companies
item.description: U.S. Sen. Dick Durbin is pushing to repeal Section 230 of a 1996 law that allows internet companies like Meta and Google to avoid liability for content posted by online users, arguing that it now allows them to operate with impunity and peddle dangerous content.
